facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic, published 2023, refers to 'the new national Digital Transformation Strategy (2020-2030)', a stated period that includes the document's date; it gives no date of adoption and neither the text nor a link to it is given, so as_of is the document's published year. Text public: not stated

The World Bank diagnostic, published 2023, states that efforts 'have been slow to adopt due to the lack of a holistic and integrative national digital development strategy' and that the government has 'no whole-of-government approach' or 'master plan for digitalization', concluding there is 'the absence of a comprehensive and consistent digital strategy'; it makes this statement while also citing the 2020-2030 strategy; as_of is the document's published year.
facts.system: holistic and integrative national digital development strategy

facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic, published 2023, recommends as a high-priority action (R1) to 'Adopt the new "Chad Digital Strategy Horizon 2030"' through an inclusive process convening ministries, industry, civil society and development partners, and that the strategy carry an implementation roadmap and a monitoring and evaluation framework; it does not say the strategy has been adopted, validated or by whom it was drafted; as_of is the document's published year.

The World Bank diagnostic, published 2023, states that the Ministry of Posts and Digital Economy (established May 2021) 'prepares and implements the national strategy and policies in the ICT and postal sectors' and that ADETIC, established by Law N°012/PR/2014, 'is mandated to implement the national digital agenda'; as_of is the document's published year.

systems.owner: Ministry of Posts and Digital Economy (MPEN); ADETIC implements the national digital agenda
systems.tiers: national, as the document calls it; scope and pillars not described
recommended for adoption; scope not described
MPEN is 'responsible for designing and supervising' it; the document does not say it exists
adopted in 2016 per the document; financial inclusion and digital financial services

note: The strategy's scope is not described, so class is left empty on the 2020-2030 and Horizon 2030 facts; the standing:none fact is about a holistic national strategy, which the document defines as whole-of-government. The document gives no adoption verb for the 2020-2030 strategy, so no standing fact for it. MPEN domestic budget (US$1.75m operating) is not tied to the strategy, so no finance fact.
